parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: The personal access token. This parameter is not required if you authenticate using an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or Security Token Service (STS) credentials.

parameters.name: labelId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the label.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The ID of the organization. You can obtain the organization ID from your browser's URL after logging in to the Alibaba Cloud DevOps console. The URL is formatted as `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`.

parameters.name: repositoryIdentity
parameters.description: The ID or full path of the repository.
